name: safeher
description: SafeHer - Travel Freely. Stay Safely. Full-Stack Women Safety Web Application

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')){fs.cpSync('client/dist','public',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('client/dist','dist',{recursive:true});}"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
